title: 3.0.0.1 dev-h SMS communicator replies are not sent
body:
3.0.0.1 dev-h
Build: d3d28605d-2022.04.03-17:55
Flavor: Full Debug
Nightscout 14.2.5
Engineering mode enabled

SMS Are received by AAPS, and shows on SMS communicator.

AAPS is replying, and the replies are shown on SMS communicator, but a text message is not created and not sent by the phone.

It is possible to send the passphrase after sending the command, and action will be taken by AAPS but very uncomfortable without the verification.

This issue was also present with 3.0.0.1 dev-g


[AndroidAPS_LOG_1649016618575.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/8405484/AndroidAPS_LOG_1649016618575.log.zip)

comments.body: there is no change in SMS code for some time. review permissions and https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/en/latest/Children/SMS-Commands.html?highlight=sms#sms-commands-not-working-on-samsung-phones

Thanks. 
I doubled checked permissions and made sure chat features are disabled.
I am using google messages for texts, but have also tried the samsung  app. Found no difference.
Chat features are disable in both google and samsung apps.

there is nothing visible in logs
aaps is trying to send the message. the rest is on OS and it's settings
sorry
